note: Governed keys referenced by element.expression. layout_primitive and interaction_primitive are now seeded from the layout engine's first real .potx (astellas_v1, GEN607). text_primitive / motion_primitive / style_ref remain to be filled. A registered key is the value an element carries in expression.layout_primitive / expression.interaction_primitive, AND (for layouts) the id a layout-engine template_manifest layout uses — one name across the manifold and the deliverable pipeline.

governance.rule: element.expression.* may only reference keys defined here. New keys require a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else.
governance.naming: layout_primitive keys are UPPER_SNAKE and equal the layout-engine template_manifest layout id (decision 2026-07-31: layout-engine ids are canonical). interaction_primitive keys are lower_snake behavior names.

layout_primitive.label: Title + Body
layout_primitive.description: Static title with a prose/bulleted body. Workhorse for low-complexity screens.

layout_primitive.label: Static 3-Card Set
layout_primitive.description: Title + intro + three peer cards, all visible. For a three-element peer set with no interaction.

layout_primitive.label: Click-to-Reveal Grid
layout_primitive.description: Prompt + grid of click-to-reveal cards with a gated Continue; each card lifts to a Storyline layer.

layout_primitive.label: Scenario Sort
layout_primitive.description: Stem + selectable option cards with per-choice feedback layers.

layout_primitive.label: Venn Diagram + Callouts
layout_primitive.description: Why-panel + 3-set venn + callouts. A convergence/overlap beat.

layout_primitive.label: Single-Best Knowledge Check
layout_primitive.description: Single-best multiple-choice knowledge check; the correct answer sets the section advancement variable.

interaction_primitive.label: Click to Reveal
interaction_primitive.description: Learner clicks each of N items to reveal its detail on a layer; progression may be gated until all are visited.

interaction_primitive.label: Scenario Select
interaction_primitive.description: Learner selects one or more option cards; each choice surfaces a per-choice feedback layer.

interaction_primitive.label: Single-Best MCQ
interaction_primitive.description: Single-best-answer multiple choice; the correct choice sets an advancement variable.
